summary: Iteration 77 — tested 7 new features: merged /cart+checkout, /checkout redirect, mixed payment, pay-later (deferred card/crypto), warehouse as admin tab, returns policy removal, contact discounts statuses removal, and chat attach/emoji testids. Backend pytest 7/7 PASSED. Frontend: all required data-testids present and functional. Mixed-payment toggle reveals mix-method-1/2 + mix-amount-1; pay-later-toggle appears when card selected and deferred_payment enabled in admin; admin has 'Склад' tab; Платежи tab has deferred-payment-switch + deferred-payment-hours and the previously-broken CardPaymentSettings (Ручная оплата на карту) is now visible.
action_items: Optional: /admin/warehouse URL does not redirect to /admin — direct navigation still resolves (renders fine but URL stays as /admin/warehouse). User request said it 'should redirect/not exist'. Consider adding <Route path='/admin/warehouse' element={<Navigate to='/admin' replace />} /> in App.js if a hard redirect is desired. NOT BLOCKING — there is no standalone page; behavior is benign.
Optional: Header.js still imports unused Warehouse icon — minor dead import.
critical_code_review_comments: CartPage.js (553 lines) — large but well-structured; reuses CartContext, AuthContext; useEffect cleanup OK; consider splitting MixedPaymentSection and PaymentMethodList into sub-components for readability.

orders.py create_order(): mixed payment correctly enforces ≤2 parts, distinct methods, parts sum ~= subtotal, applies per-part adjustment via (1 + adj/100), allocates delivery_fee to non-balance part. payment_due_date set only when pay_later && method in {card,crypto} && not balance/deferral/mixed — matches spec.
payment_status enum proliferation (paid|unpaid|awaiting_confirmation|awaiting_payment|deferred) is correct; UI status was tested as field 'payment_status' (not 'status').
Header.js imports Warehouse from lucide-react but never renders a Склад nav link — dead import (request requirement satisfied).
App.js has only /checkout -> Navigate(/cart); no /admin/warehouse Navigate route — direct URL stays put without 404. Consider explicit redirect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all targeted data-testids present and interactive flows verified)

seed_data_creation: Created during tests: 1 card pay-later order, 1 mixed (cash+card) order, 1 cash order — all with full_name='TEST*'. Admin /admin/payment-settings was set deferred_payment_enabled=true / hours=24 (restored to enabled=true so frontend can show pay-later). Cart was cleared and re-seeded with 1 product via /cart/add for the client.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed data-testids on /cart: cart-page, checkout-fullname/address/phone/comment, payment-method-cash/card/crypto/balance/deferral, mixed-payment-toggle, mix-method-1/2, mix-amount-1, terms-checkbox, checkout-total, place-order-btn, free-delivery-bar, pay-later-toggle (shows when card/crypto+deferred enabled). /checkout redirects to /cart. Admin tabs: ['Каталог','Склад','Бонусы','Платежи','CRM','Маркетинг','Логи','Настройки'] — warehouse is now a tab. Admin /Платежи has deferred-payment-switch + deferred-payment-hours + Ручная оплата на карту card-payment-settings block (previous iter76 issue resolved). Contact chat has contact-chat-attach + contact-chat-emoji. ClientReturnsPage no longer renders 'Условия и правила возврата' block. Backend auth uses 'token' not 'access_token'. Admin payment settings update endpoint is PUT /api/admin/payment-settings (NOT /api/payment-settings which is GET-only). Order schema: payment_method='card|cash|crypto|balance|deferral|mixed', payment_status='awaiting_confirmation|awaiting_payment|paid|unpaid|deferred', payment_due_date isoformat string for pay_later/crypto-due. Mixed order has payment_parts=[{method, amount}, ...].
